_comment: Template for cs-demo-downloader (https://github.com/Claabs/cs-demo-downloader). See demo-downloader/README.md for the full setup walkthrough (bot account, .maFile, Steam Web API key, player onboarding). NEVER commit real values — all entries below are placeholders.

authCodeLogin._comment: Credentials of the DEDICATED Steam account that the bot logs in as. This account must be Steam Guard mobile-authenticator-enabled; the `secret` is the `shared_secret` field from the .maFile exported by Steam Desktop Authenticator.

authCodes._comment: Add one entry per player whose matches the bot should fetch. The `authCode` is the Game Authentication Code from help.steampowered.com (see README). `oldestShareCode` is the most recent share-code the player has already given us — the bot walks back from there.
